title: A security baseline is behind the current version

report.title: {Items.Count} security {Plural(Items.Count, 'baseline is', 'baselines are')} not the current version

messages.businessImpact: Settings added to protect against newer techniques are missing, and the version in use may configure things Microsoft has since changed its advice about.
remediation: Create a new profile from the current baseline version, compare the differences, and migrate the assignment.
messages.cannotSee: What Microsoft says about the template is read, not what the difference between the versions amounts to. A baseline on a superseded template may be missing a great deal or almost nothing, and this cannot tell which. The judgement is the tenant's own template list rather than a list of versions the pack carries, so a run that could not read that list reports no baseline as behind rather than every one of them, and a lifecycle word this release has no opinion about leaves the baseline unjudged.
